text: Some years ago: Miss Stoner once sees inside the safe, full of papers
why: At ¶162 Helen says she has seen inside the safe only once, some years ago, and that it was full of papers.

text: What is really kept in the iron safe in Dr. Roylott's room? — Helen has seen inside only once, some years ago
why: The question is open, and the story gives reason to ask it: Holmes has just found a dummy bell-rope and a fake ventilator and examined the room with keen interest. Helen's single past look inside the safe is also stated in ¶162. The word 'really' hints that the papers may not be the whole answer, but the story has given readers grounds for that doubt.
